review_description: Wow! What a great decision it was to go with Sunsmart for our solar installation.We tried other companies and they only cared about their profit.The team was brilliant and made everything so easy to understand. Our bills were reduced by 80%!The system looks great on the roof, and the performance has exceeded our expectations. If you're thinking about going solar, this is the company to call!

Right from the beginning nothing was too much trouble to explain or follow up. Unfortunately where I live has restrictions on size of system. But the team took it in their stride and negotiated directly on my behalf and explained all the additional processes in a manner I understood. The job was commenced and completed efficiently. The team cleaned up and took rubbish away.
No sales person garbage. The installer is the business owner. Fantastic communication, superb installation. Absolutely NO problems.

The quote was quick and built around our specific circumstances. We have many trees near us and this was fully considered in the design of our system. The installation was quick and the team were very nice to deal with. The full process was handled confidently and i am very happy with what we have received.
